host_assumptions: The host computes signature, nonce, replay, expiry, pause, oracle freshness, route, quote receipt, pool snapshot, hop-count, slippage, fee-cap, amount, liquidity, risk, proof, binding, balance, and token-admission predicates before invoking Tau.
Every host predicate passed to Tau is encoded as an sbf bit where 1 means the named predicate passed and 0 means it failed.
Action decoding is performed before Tau and is supplied as one-hot sbf flags i1..i4.
non_claims: This experiment does not prove signature verification, receipt verification, balance accounting, or arithmetic correctness.
This experiment is not runtime-active and is not a production admission policy until promoted through formal Tau contracts and host-binding tests.
runtime_activation_blockers: Create a formal/tau contract and behavior atlas for the exact intended runtime meaning.
Bind the host-side predicates to concrete code paths with positive and negative integration tests.
Run Tau differential traces and record exact generated artifacts for every promoted output vector.
Document operator-visible failure meanings for all diagnostic outputs.

host_assumptions: The host computes every base admission predicate used by settlement_admission_envelope_v1.

The host also computes previous-admission-state, chain-height monotonicity, writer-epoch, batch-capacity, duplicate-pool, oracle-diversity, signer-capability, and emergency-mode predicates before invoking Tau.
The emergency-mode predicate encodes the complete host policy for whether the selected action is allowed during emergency operation.
non_claims: This experiment does not prove chain synchronization, writer scheduling, oracle diversity, signer authorization, or emergency governance correctness.
This experiment is not runtime-active and is not a production temporal admission policy until promoted through formal Tau contracts and host-binding tests.
runtime_activation_blockers: Create a formal/tau contract and behavior atlas covering all ten outputs.
Bind node-progress and governance/oracle predicates to concrete runtime code with exact failure traces.
Run Tau differential traces and record exact generated artifacts for every promoted output vector.
Define incident-response documentation for pause and emergency-mode diagnostics.
